name: daily_brief_asks_v4
description: Brief Needs-you (aegis-zmk): every open seed carrying a human-gate label, one row per gate, with bounded OPTIONS/REC excerpts. Read-only; measured 0.26s/51KB on 45b2333e.
scope: every open human-gated seed (blocked:human, needs-stiwi, decision-stiwi, desk, decision-needed), excluding inbox and stiwi-later; up to 400 gate facts, overflow is UNKNOWN
template: PREFIX schema: <https://schema.org/> PREFIX seeds: <https://seeds.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> PREFIX ical: <http://www.w3.org/2002/12/cal/ical#> SELECT ?item ?id ?title ?priority ?rank ?status ?owner ?due ?revision ?modified ?created ?gate ?options ?rec WHERE { GRAPH <https://seeds.local/project/aegis> { VALUES ?gate { "blocked:human" "needs-stiwi" "decision-stiwi" "desk" "decision-needed" } ?item schema:keywords ?gate . ?item seeds:priority ?priority ; seeds:status ?status . FILTER(?status != "closed" && ?status != "tombstone") FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item schema:keywords "inbox" } FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?item schema:keywords "stiwi-later" } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:identifier ?id } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:name ?title } OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:rank ?rank } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:version ?revision } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:dateModified ?modified } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:dateCreated ?created } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:agent ?owner } OPTIONAL { ?item ical:due ?due } OPTIONAL { ?item schema:description ?desc } OPTIONAL { ?item seeds:notes ?notes } BIND(CONCAT(COALESCE(?desc, ""), "\n", COALESCE(?notes, "")) AS ?text) BIND(LCASE(?text) AS ?low) BIND(IF(CONTAINS(?low, "options:"), SUBSTR(?text, STRLEN(STRBEFORE(?low, "options:")) + 9, 280), "") AS ?options) BIND(IF(CONTAINS(?low, "recommendation:"), SUBSTR(?text, STRLEN(STRBEFORE(?low, "recommendation:")) + 16, 240), IF(CONTAINS(?low, "rec:"), SUBSTR(?text, STRLEN(STRBEFORE(?low, "rec:")) + 5, 240), "")) AS ?rec) } } ORDER BY ?priority ?id ?gate LIMIT 400
